list.snippet: IT & Tech Services: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Infosys, Wipro, Persistent Systems, Cognizant, and Epam Systems.

Global Corporates & MNCs: Eaton, Ecolab, and Avient Corporation.
Query & Database Tools: Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
Visualization Platforms: Experience with Power BI and Tableau for dashboard creation.
Programming Languages: Python or R for advanced data processing.
Core Competencies: Advanced Excel, data cleaning, and stakeholder management.
